meta.name: linkedin-comment-drafter
meta.description: Draft a LinkedIn comment on someone else's post from its URL, or reshare (repost) it to your feed with optional commentary. Use when the user pastes a post URL and asks to comment, engage, be first commenter, or repost with their thoughts. Produces 1-3 variants in the user's voice, picks a reaction, and publishes via Publora on approval. Not for replying to existing comments (use linkedin-reply-handler).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 粘贴帖子链接,生成你口吻的评论并发布或转发
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常在 LinkedIn 参与讨论,想快速写出得体评论并转发
copy.tagline_en: Paste a post link to get comment drafts in your voice, then publish or reshare
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engage on LinkedIn often and want quick, on-brand comment drafts

howto.what: 你发来一条 LinkedIn 帖子链接，它会抓取帖子内容，按 7 个模板写出 1–3 条 200–350 字符的评论草稿，附推荐反应类型，等你确认后经 Publora 发布。
howto.when: 当你粘贴 LinkedIn 帖子链接并说「评论一下」「帮我写条评论」等，或想抢在病毒帖前几条评论、回答作者结尾提问时触发。

say.text: 评论这条帖子：<LinkedIn 帖子链接>
say.note: 抓取帖子并给出评论草稿

say.text: 抢在这条帖子前几条评论，用我的语气
say.note: 生成变体，等你确认后发布

say.text: 帮我想个更尖锐的问题来回复这篇帖子
say.note: 套用提问模板生成草稿

howto.what_en: Paste a LinkedIn post URL and it fetches the post, drafts 1-3 comment variants of 200-350 characters from 7 templates, assigns a reaction type, and publishes via Publora after you approve.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste a LinkedIn post URL and ask to comment on it, be an early commenter, or answer the author's closing question.

say_en.note: Fetches the post and drafts comments

say_en.text: Be one of the first commenters on this link
Draft a sharper question reply to this post
